items.title: I think I don't know how to talk to people
items.text:
I think I don't know how to talk to people
I started to realize that when chatting with somebody I often end up talking about me, because I don't know how to talk about the other person or whatever the other person is telling me. I can talk about various topics, but when it comes to someone telling me an anecdote or how their day was I just don't know what to say. It makes me sick and it saddens me because I fear I sound like an egocentric piece of shit, always talking about me. I care for a few people, but I don't know how to show it
What do you listen to? Thrash, Death, Doom, Black?

That might be something, but I'm sure you didn't even asked her to be your prom date (please correct me if I'm wrong).
Tell her about what you feel, that should make things clear between you two. Keep in mind that she didn't say "no" to you, YOU said "no" to yourself.
If she's not in a relationship, go for it.
Thanks for the words, I'll think about what you said

I don't really know, I'm not from the US so I don't know much about prom. Anyway, talk to her while she's still single.
Now, I'm not saying she'll fall in love with you or something, but I advice you to not let your feelings rot inside you.
As someone who don't even know what it feels to hold hands with someone that loves you I do really wish the best for you. Do what you think would be best for yourself.

If you wish we can chat about it, all the time I don't spend sleeping is free time for me
Ouch :c
I wouldn't know either. I guess you can talk to her about this "as friends" situation if it really bothers you.
You're welcome, I tried my best and I hope you do too. Good luck.

items.title: Roses are red, I want to go away, my friends didn't wake up for my birthday
items.text:
Roses are red, I want to go away, my friends didn't wake up for my birthday
So, a couple of days ago I planned a bbq to celebrate my birthday with my friends and I let them choose the day and hour (I preferred Saturday night, a day prior to my birthday) so all of them, or at least most of them could be present and we finally agreed on Sunday at around 12pm.
I woke up this morning and started texting them, but only one was awake (they went to a club last night). After chatting a while with him we waited to see if anybody else woke up, but nothing. Near 1pm I texted them again (most of them are still sleeping, and it's like 2pm) to say the bbq was cancelled. I ended up eating scrambled eggs alone. 
My disappointment and contempt are immeasurable. I don't even care about my damned bday, for me it's just an excuse to eat pizza or something with my friends.

One of my friends apologized and walked to my house when he woke up and then we met up with the one that I chatted with in the morning. We had a good time so the day wasn't as bad. (The other 10 guys didn't say or do shit)
Gracias por escribir, saludos desde Argentina.

Turns out that one of them woke up, apologized and walked to my house. We met up with the one that did remember about my bday and we had a good time. Wasn't that bad after all, but I'll never forget the disappointment.
Out of like 11 guys only two had the decency to be real friends
Yeah, I know. And when they do show up they're always late, ALWAYS, and not 5 to 15 minutes late, but like an hour or an hour and a half
Hahahahahaha thanks dude
Ohh, my bad hahaha 😅
I can't have peace in my own house because I (19) still live with my mother and sister, but that sounds pretty cool though

Five years of no crying, limited emotions, not being able to "release" my true feelings and everything feeling or being kinda "meh". I'm, to this day, not able to put real effort into something (except for one attempt at a relationship that ended bad for me). The story is a bit long and confusing
I told them Saturday night was better, but the majority agreed that midday Sunday was better. It really sucks
Your words are much appreciated
You did nothing wrong and you're not repulsive, that woman is repulsive.

items.title: "I wish your brother and you were normal, like your sister" - My mother
items.text:
"I wish your brother and you were normal, like your sister" - My mother
Am I doing something wrong? The way they constantly misunderstand what I say suggests that I'm terrible at expressing myself or that they don't listen to me. I tried in many ways to explain why I'm surly, unexpressive, lethargic, and why I seem to lack determination but they simply found my reasoning to be incomprehensible.
When I say I want or like something they always doubt that I really do. If I say "no" it's like they hear "maybe"

It makes me feel sad and kind of rejected to have parents like that, but I still have to live here for like 4 or 5 years at least. Any advice on how I can avoid feeling contempt, anger or sadness every time I talk with my parents?

Thanks for writing and sorry I took too long to answer, I've been busy the past couple of days.

Yes, I know I'm not the problem, and plenty of people told me that too. I started to go to a psychiatrist and she ended up giving me some drugs to raise my serotonin (I'm very sceptical about it). She said I probably won't be able to communicate properly with my parents, ever, so the best I can do is not give a damn, and appreciate their effort (which I do, in my own way). I still think if they made a better effort to understand me it would be much better.

Once the psychiatrist understood the situation with my parents she quickly started to look for something else that could be hindering me, and we will be dealing"rejection" from now on.

items.title: Where is this "someone better"?
items.text:
Where is this "someone better"?

I'm pretty sure she meant someone better than her, but that's just her. But as for any other person I can see it being as you say
Thank you, I often forget that
